verses.translation: Woe to the defrauders

verses.arabicText: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
verses.transliteration: Alladhīna idhā ik'tālū ʿalā n-nāsi yastawfūn
verses.translation: Those who take full measure ˹when they buy˺ from people
but give less when they measure or weigh for buyers
Do such people not think that they will be resurrected
for a tremendous Day—
the Day ˹all˺ people will stand before the Lord of all worlds

verses.arabicText: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Kallā inna kitāba l-fujāri lafī sijjīnin
verses.translation: But no! The wicked are certainly bound for Sijjîn ˹in the depths of Hell˺—
and what will make you realize what Sijjîn is?—
a fate ˹already˺ sealed
Woe on that Day to the deniers—
those who deny Judgment Day

verses.arabicText: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
verses.transliteration: Wamā yukadhibu bihi illā kullu muʿ'tadin athīmin
verses.translation: None would deny it except every evildoing transgressor

verses.arabicText: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Idhā tut'lā ʿalayhi āyātunā qāla asāṭīru l-awalīn
verses.translation: Whenever Our revelations are recited to them, they say, “Ancient fables!”

verses.arabicText: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Kallā bal rāna ʿalā qulūbihim mā kānū yaksibūn
verses.translation: But no! In fact, their hearts have been stained by all ˹the evil˺ they used to commit

verses.arabicText: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ
verses.translation: Undoubtedly, they will be sealed off from their Lord on that Day
Moreover, they will surely burn in Hell

verses.arabicText: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Thumma yuqālu hādhā alladhī kuntum bihi tukadhibūn
verses.translation: and then be told, “This is what you used to deny.”

verses.arabicText: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ
verses.transliteration: Kallā inna kitāba l-abrāri lafī ʿilliyyīn
verses.translation: But no! The virtuous are certainly bound for ’Illiyûn ˹in elevated Gardens˺—
and what will make you realize what ’Illiyûn is?—
a fate ˹already˺ sealed
witnessed by those nearest ˹to Allah˺
Surely the virtuous will be in bliss
˹seated˺ on ˹canopied˺ couches, gazing around
You will recognize on their faces the glow of delight
They will be given a drink of sealed, pure wine

verses.arabicText: خِتَٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌۭ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَٰفِسُونَ
verses.translation: whose last sip will smell like musk. So let whoever aspires to this strive ˹diligently˺
And this drink’s flavour will come from Tasnîm—
a spring from which those nearest ˹to Allah˺ will drink

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ
verses.transliteration: Inna alladhīna ajramū kānū mina alladhīna āmanū yaḍḥakūn
verses.translation: Indeed, the wicked used to laugh at the believers
wink to one another whenever they passed by

verses.arabicText: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-idhā inqalabū ilā ahlihimu inqalabū fakihīn
verses.translation: and muse ˹over these exploits˺ upon returning to their own people

verses.arabicText: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-idhā ra-awhum qālū inna hāulāi laḍāllūn
verses.translation: And when they saw the faithful, they would say, “These ˹people˺ are truly astray,”
even though they were not sent as keepers over the believers

verses.arabicText: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fal-yawma alladhīna āmanū mina l-kufāri yaḍḥakūn
verses.translation: But on that Day the believers will be laughing at the disbelievers
as they sit on ˹canopied˺ couches, looking on

verses.arabicText: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Hal thuwwiba l-kufāru mā kānū yafʿalūn
verses.translation: ˹The believers will be asked,˺ “Have the disbelievers ˹not˺ been paid back for what they used to do?”
